reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was a new brand with zero reviews, and there is no NSF or USP seal on the box. The sachets are handy for my gym bag and car, but I already take Thorne and I don't switch a sleep supplement to something unproven.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A QR code to the brand's own lab report is nice, but anyone can print one, and I trust a third-party certification more.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, or a few hundred verified reviews from people who have used it for months.
